dct_description_sm: This dataset contains the following administrative boundaries: ADM0, ADM1, ADM2, ADM3. Produced and maintained since 2017, the geoBoundaries Global Database of Political Administrative Boundaries Database [www.geoboundaries.org](https://www.geoboundaries.org) is an open license, standardized resource of boundaries (i.e., state, county) for every country in the world.
